transcript: Speaker A: फटीचर आदमी, तेरी हिम्मत कैसे हुई मेरी बेटी पर नज़र डालने की? [You worthless man, how dare you look at my daughter?] Speaker B: Sir, I love your daughter very much. Sir, it has expert videos, teaching English by explaining in Hindi in short 2 to 5-minute videos. And sir, there is a show called Spoken English, a video ends in the time it takes to watch a reel. But sir, you get nothing from reels, you get English from these videos. Sir, the best part is it has an AI coach, available 24 hours. Learn from experts and practice with the AI coach. And sir, the AI coach never judged me, I practiced without shame. And sir, your daughter told me about this app. Sir, without it, I wouldn't even get a promotion in office.] Speaker A: बेटा, मुझसे गलती हो गई। दो दिल जो एक दूसरे से इतना प्यार करते हैं, उनके बीच में मुझे नहीं आना चाहिए था। मैंने तुम्हें बिना बात के जज कर लिया। माफ़ करना बेटा। [Son, I made a mistake. I shouldn't have come between two hearts that love each other so much. I judged you without reason. Forgive me, son.] Speaker B: अगर तुम्हें भी लड़कियों के बाप से फटीचर सुनना पड़ता है, या खुद अपनी गर्लफ्रेंड को प्राउड फील कराना है, तो भाई इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड कर लो। ₹1 का ट्रायल है, रोज़ के सिर्फ 15 मिनट एआई कोच के साथ। इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो आज ही। [If you also have to hear 'worthless' from girls' fathers, or want to make your girlfriend proud, then brother, download the English Seekho app. There is a ₹1 trial, just 15 minutes daily with the AI coach. Download the English Seekho app today.] Speaker C: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho. INSTALL NOW. English Seekho kisi bhi government authority... [English Seekho is not associated with any government authority...]
summary: An angry father insults his daughter's boyfriend, but is silenced when the boyfriend speaks fluent English. The boyfriend credits his success and career promotion to the English Seekho app's short lessons and AI coach. He invites viewers to download the app for a 1-rupee trial to avoid social embarrassment.
